entries.quote: Britain is at particular risk of stagflation, due to post-Brexit labour shortages and its dependence on expensive natural gas.
entries.subject: UK stagflation

entries.quote: Meanwhile, as much as half of business travel is gone for good.
entries.subject: Business travel recovery

entries.quote: 2022 will be the first year in which more people go to space as paying passengers than government employees, carried aloft by rival space-tourism firms.
entries.subject: Space tourism passengers vs government astronauts

entries.quote: China will finish its new space station.
entries.subject: Tiangong space station completion

entries.quote: And nasa will crash a space probe into an asteroid, in a real-life mission that sounds like a Hollywood film.
entries.subject: NASA DART asteroid impact

entries.quote: Expect protests directed at both host countries, though boycotts by national teams seem unlikely.
entries.subject: Beijing Winter Olympics and Qatar World Cup boycotts

entries.quote: We correctly predicted Emmanuel Macron’s win in France and Jair Bolsonaro’s loss in Brazil, that “Bongbong” Marcos would prevail in the Philippines, and that the MPLA would hold on in Angola.
entries.subject: Elections in France, Brazil, Philippines and Angola
